# 2_extracted_text

The books' text is extracted to the code cache, outside the repo (copyright). This folder keeps only one **sections file** per book (`<book>.sections.jsonl`): the brought-in pages cut into pieces at the book's own headings, each with its section number, title, line ranges, a fingerprint of its words, and the definitions it uses (the IBC by its italics; NFPA 101 by every Chapter 3 term it prints, 3.1). Tables are pieces of their own. No words of the books but section titles and defined terms.

**Generated by code only. Never hand-edit.** `python -m document_extraction` reads each book's brought-in pages from the cache, column by column (`layout: two_column`: `packages/document_extraction/document_extraction/columns.py` and `columns_sections.py`), and writes these files; `--check` writes nothing and fails if either differs from a fresh extraction. Where the cache is missing (CI), it is skipped and says so. The IBC's text is its copy's OCR, misreads included: they are named in the labels' notes, never corrected here.
